assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness accompanied by a recent history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic etiologies contributing to these neurological and vestibular symptoms.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to identify cardiac causes underlying the recurrent dizziness and recent transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
The service is coded as CPT 93229.
The patient's diagnoses are G45.9 and R42.
The claim was denied under reason code CO-197.
